entities.title: EU Blue Card
entities.summary: The EU Blue Card is a residence and work permit for highly skilled workers from outside the EU. To apply, you need a valid employment contract with a company in Germany, a recognized university degree, and to fulfill one of the salary requirements.
eligibility: Valid employment contract with a company in Germany
Yearly gross salary of at least €48,300 (as per 2025) or €43,759.80 (as per 2025) with specific conditions
application_process: Familiarize yourself with the visa category and its requirements
Prepare your visa application using the provided checklist
important_notes: Check if you might qualify for another category if you do not meet the requirements for the EU Blue Card
A list of understaffed professions can be found on the make-it-in-germany website

min_income_threshold.notes: Lower threshold of €43,759.80 applies under certain conditions
